description: Land Acquisition - Block 01 of Cad. Map No. 810019 of Maligaspe, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of 23 specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose. It contains no government personnel changes, structural changes, or portfolio assignments. The content focuses entirely on land matters (descriptions, locations, claimants, extents), making it a clear example of a Land Gazette.
